description: This file defines a REST API resource class 'LoanCapitalizedIncomeApiResource' for handling HTTP requests related to loan capitalized income data in the Apache Fineract project. It provides endpoints to fetch capitalized income details, data by loan ID or external ID, and associated amortization allocations.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints to access loan capitalized income data, including details, by IDs or external IDs, and loan transaction allocations.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeData
methods.description: Fetches loan capitalized income data by loan ID. Deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: fetchLoanCapitalizedIncomeDataByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches loan capitalized income data by external ID. Deprecated endpoint.

methods.name: fetchCapitalizedIncomeDetails
methods.description: Fetches list of capitalized incomes details for a loan by loan ID.

methods.name: fetchCapitalizedIncomeDetailsByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches list of capitalized incomes details for a loan by external ID.

methods.name: retrieveCapitalizedIncomeAllocationData
methods.description: Core method to retrieve capitalized income allocation data by various ID types and transaction IDs, returning JSON string.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByLoanExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data by loan external ID and loan transaction ID.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByTransactionExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data by loan ID and transaction external ID.

methods.name: getCapitalizedIncomeAllocationDataByExternalIds
methods.description: Retrieves capitalized income allocation data by external IDs for loan and transaction.
